However, there were several distinctions from to this overall organization. For example, cortical and thalamic areas comprising higher proportion of GABAergic cells included the accessory olfactory bulb (AOB), main olfactory bulb (MOB), nucleus of the lateral olfactory tract (NLOT), basomedial amygdalar nucleus (BMA) and endopiriform nucleus, ventral part (EPv) in the cortex and the intergeniculate leaflet of the lateral geniculate complex (IGL), peripeduncular nucleus (PP), ventral part of the lateral geniculate complex (LGv) and reticular thalamus (RT) in the thalamus (Figure 3B-C).
